subject: Acquirer request: temporary access & sanitization runbook for due diligence logs
messages:
From: Ellie Stokes <ellie.stokes@acmehealth.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-lived log access for acquisition diligence

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for taking time earlier. As part of Acme's standard acquisition diligence we need to validate retention/deletion controls for customer logs and backups. Specifically we want to sample:
- API request traces (last 90 days)
- Backup manifest + deletion timestamps for the last 6 months
- Evidence of secure erasure for deleted snapshots

We understand this is sensitive. We only need a short-lived snapshot (read-only) and an attestation that search indexes/PII were redacted. Can Redwood provide a sanitized snapshot or a secure viewing environment? Also: any subprocessors involved in backup or archival storage and their regions.

Please send your standard runbook and timeline for a sanitized handoff. Acme legal will sign an NDA + DPA addendum if needed.

Best,
Ellie
M&A Lead, Acme Health

Attachments: acme_dpa_questionnaire.xlsx (sent separately)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ellie.stokes@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: short-lived log access for acquisition diligence

Forwarding Acme's request — they want a sanitized snapshot and confirmation of subprocessors.
Ask: can we propose a plan that:
1) creates a read-only sanitized snapshot in a locked S3 (or equivalent) for 30 days
2) provides a scrub report and retention audit for the last 6 months
3) enumerates subprocessors + KMS regions used for backups
4) includes a rollback/escrow if we need to re-run the scrub
Marcus: need feasibility and estimated outage/risk.
Kim: legal knobs (DPA language / limited-scope attestation).
Laura: security acceptance criteria (redaction, verification, chain-of-custody).

Thanks — Rafael
Head of Partnerships (on the thread with Acme)

Attachment stubs: dd_snapshot_manifest.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ellie.stokes@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 12:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short-lived log access for acquisition diligence

Thanks Rafael. High level legal position / constraints:
- We can accept a time-limited delivery for diligence (recommended 30 days maximum) under a DPA addendum that includes: scope-limited access, no index-importing, and explicit prohibition on re-identification attempts.
- Redwood cannot export unredacted PII. Any exported log data must be redacted/scrubbed to our standard. We can provide proof of redaction via hash manifests and redaction scripts.
- Subprocessors: we must declare current backup/archival subprocessors (CloudStore Inc. us-east-1, ImmutableArchives ap-south-1 for cold snapshots). We can provide SOC2+processing locations.
- If Acme requires a longer window or re-runs of the scrub, require an executed amendment and procurement sign-off.

Please consider the following runbook we can propose to Acme: (ops + sec to confirm timings)
- T0: Create immutable snapshot (internal id: DD-ACME-20260909) and hold in a locked bucket
- T0+24h: Run automated redaction + produce scrub report and redaction manifest (sha256 of redaction operation per file)
- T0+48h: Security verification; provide read-only access to a salted viewer for named acquirer accounts OR provide export of scrubbed bundle to dedicated bucket with MFA delete disabled and access expiry = 30 days
- Within 30 days: Acme may request a one-time verification rerun; any additional requests require amendment
- T30: Auto-delete + cryptographic key revocation + retention log entry 

I will draft the DPA addendum language and indicate the limited scope. Marcus/Laura: confirm tech feasibility & log retention exceptions (if we need to retain ephemeral debug traces for rollback).

Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood

Attachment: acme_dpa_questionnaire.xlsx (noted)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ellie.stokes@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 15:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short-lived log access for acquisition diligence

We can do the technical flow with the following details and risks:
- Snapshot creation: take consistent snapshot of logging tier + backup manifests (will use existing snapshot tooling). Estimated runtime: 2-6 hours depending on retention size. Snapshot id: DD-ACME-20260909-1.
- Redaction: run our PII scrub pipeline (regex + ML classifier) producing redacted bundle + redaction manifest. We will also produce a scrub audit: counts of removed identifiers and sample hashes. Estimated runtime: 6 hours for full 6-month window.
- Delivery options: 1) Provide salted web viewer in a locked VPC (preferred - no data egress), or 2) place scrubbed bundle in a dedicated bucket with time-limited access (30d) and MFA delete disabled. Option 1 avoids export risk.
- Subprocessors: CloudStore (backup object store, us-east-1), ArchiveLabs (cold archive, eu-west-1) — both have SOC2. We will include subprocessor manifest and certificate snapshots. Note: ArchiveLabs stores immutable cold snapshots for 90 days by default; we can request an expedited purge but may need contract amendment.
- Rollback/escape hatch: keep an internal ephemeral staging copy for 14 days after delivery (not accessible externally) to allow re-sanitization if Acme flags issues. After 14 days that internal copy will be destroyed and KMS keys rotated.

Risks/asks:
- If Acme requests full unredacted logs for a narrow set of accounts, legal needs to approve and we need a signed amendment.
- If ArchiveLabs refuses expedited purge, we must coordinate legal with their subprocessor team.

Proposed timeline (if greenlit today):
Day 0: Snapshot
Day 1: Redaction run + internal QA
Day 2: Security review + provide viewer + scrub report
Day 30: Auto-delete + key rotation
Day 44: Internal ephemeral staging destroyed

I'll attach the technical playbook and the scrub script (log-scrub-playbook.md).

Marcus
Director, Platform Ops

Attachments: log-scrub-playbook.md

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ellie.stokes@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short-lived log access for acquisition diligence

Security acceptance criteria — must be explicit in the runbook we hand to Acme:
1) Redaction verification: we produce both the redacted artifacts AND a sample verification report showing before/after counts (PII tokens removed) + deterministic hashes for lines removed so Acme can validate we altered specific records without seeing original content.
2) Chain of custody: record all accesses in an immutable audit log; provide certified export of the audit log for the 30-day window.
3) KMS handling: cryptographic keys used for the snapshot must be rotated at T30 and key access restricted to a named internal list. If any subprocessor needs the data, ensure key wrapping in their region and provide proof of key destruction when purge is requested.
4) Subprocessor carveouts: for ArchiveLabs exceptions, we will add a procedural note in the DPA addendum that discloses retention windows per subprocessor and any required lead time for purging cold snapshots.

I approve the technical timeline with one change: extend internal ephemeral staging to 30 days but keep it inaccessible externally — this lets us handle reruns while limiting external risk. If Acme insists on shorter exposure, we can shorten staging to 7 days.

Laura
Head of Security, Redwood

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: ellie.stokes@acmehealth.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-lived log access for acquisition diligence — proposed runbook & next steps

Ellie — thanks for the request. Internal teams have greenlit a proposed approach. Summary and next steps:
- We will create snapshot DD-ACME-20260909-1 and run full redaction for the requested 6-month window.
- Delivery option: salted read-only viewer hosted in a locked VPC (preferred). If you require a data bundle we will place a scrubbed bundle in a dedicated bucket (30-day expiry).
- Internal ephemeral staging will be retained for 30 days for reruns only and then destroyed with KMS rotation.
- Subprocessors: CloudStore (us-east-1), ArchiveLabs (eu-west-1) — ArchiveLabs cold retention may require a 14-day lead for purge; we'll list that in the DPA addendum.
- Legal: Kimberly will send a DPA addendum with the limited scope and non-reidentification clause.
- Security: Laura will provide the acceptance checklist and the redaction verification template.

Please confirm whether Acme prefers the VPC viewer (preferred by Redwood) or scrubbed bundle export. Once you confirm we will start the snapshot. Also attach any required signature pages for the DPA amendment and we will loop Procurement.

Next meeting: propose Fri 2026-09-11 10am PT to finalize scope.

Thanks,
Rafael

Attachments referenced: dd_snapshot_manifest.csv, log-scrub-playbook.md
